data.name: MWM_001
data.value: This wind is relentless...[pause=15] We must be really high up now.

data.name: MWM_002
data.value: Hey...[pause=10] did you feel that? The ground shook.

data.name: MWM_004
data.value: A Gligar burst out of the wall!

data.name: MWM_005
data.value: A Skarmory dive-bombing![pause=10] There's two of them!

data.name: MWM_008
data.value: One commands the earth, the other the skies.[pause=20] Together, they are nearly invincible.

data.name: MWM_009
data.value: But every sentinel has its weakness...[pause=20] Find it.

data.name: MWM_010
data.value: We'll show them what we're made of![pause=10] Attack!

data.name: MWM_011
data.value: We're not giving up.[pause=15] This time, we break through!

data.name: MWM_012
data.value: We got the upper hand![pause=10] Those two won't stop us anymore.

data.name: MWM_013
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] You think it gave us a hint?

data.name: MWM_014
data.value: Maybe.[pause=20] Or maybe it just wants to see us succeed.

data.name: MWM_016
data.value: Learn from this defeat.[pause=30] The summit awaits only the strongest.
